text: COSTUME_SILLA_LABORER_A01 V02 (evidence-corrected, CLM_SILLA_COSTUME_021-031): Silla labourer, 5th to early 6th century. ONE coarse, unbleached, loosely woven plain-weave jacket, hip length, LONG narrow sleeves to the wrist, straight collar crossed shallowly (right over left or left over right), no ribbon ties; narrow plain trousers; a simple twisted cloth waist cord, no metal; straw sandals; hair in a topknot, bare or with a plain cloth band; natural off-white, grey-brown or dark undyed tones, dusty and worn. FEWEST items of all ranks: no cap, no belt ornament, no bag. The collar closes with the belt only; no dangling chest tie or ribbon-like cord at the collar (seen in 09-17 samples). Forbidden: short sleeves, bare chest as default, ankle-bound trousers, futou hat, bronze or iron belt buckle, Joseon hanbok silhouette, ribbon ties, gat hat, bright dye, official colours.
